text:
nina: quick idea - introduce "affinity_seed" in rollout metadata as a single advisory string to help clients prefer warmed variants without hard pins. keeps resolver simple.
omar: advisory-only sounds right. what's the minimum schema?
nina: proposal: affinity_seed (string), seed_ttl_sec (int), seed_bias (0-100). resolver precedence unchanged: explicit->sticky->canary->affinity_seed->weighted fallback.
kevin: tie-breaks? if multiple manifests supply seeds, deterministic rule needed. suggest: highest seed_bias then smallest sha prefix.
jess: telemetry: emit resolver_used enum (explicit,sticky,canary,seed,fallback), seed_applied bool, seed_id when applied, fallback_reason. we need these to monitor hot-spotting.
omar: generator note: rollout-generator should namespace seeds across shards and limit seeds-per-shard to N. default seed_bias conservative (20).
kevin: tenant controls: hosted default on, dedicated/private default off unless tenant enables. document behavior in rollout contract and Console.
ina: example patch for RFC addendum:
```json
{
  "variants": ["v1", "v1-8bit"],
  "affinity_seed": "s-2026-03",
  "seed_ttl_sec": 300,
  "seed_bias": 25
}
```
jess: test plan: small canary with seed_bias ramp 0->25, measure cold-start and per-shard concentration. add alert if any shard receives >X seeds in 5m.
ops-bot: note created: affinity_seed advisory + telemetry + generator guardrails. assigned: @nina, @jess. :memo:
nina: i'll draft RFC addendum with schema diff, resolver pseudocode, telemetry event list, generator changes, and load-test plan. review in 1 week. :thumbsup:
